Subject: Question on July invoice — token counts look off / VAT reverse-charge

Hi Neha / Ben,

We've been reconciling our July ledger and noticed the July invoice (Inv #RDW-AT-0728) shows ~2.3M embedding tokens billed for our embedding index refresh, but our internal export (attached) only shows ~1.78M calls and ~1.9M estimated tokens. That's a ~20% delta which is material to our P&L this quarter.

Separately, Atlas is a Dutch entity (VAT NL123456789B01) and we expected the invoice to be net of VAT under the EU reverse-charge — the invoice we received still shows VAT added. Can you please: 
- Provide the raw usage export used to generate the billed token counts (per-prefix if possible)
- Explain any counting rules that might add tokens (streaming vs completed-only, prefix padding, system messages)
- Reissue a net invoice if reverse-charge applies, or provide evidence that VAT is required

I've attached our internal CSV export for July and copied Finance. We need this clarified before we finalize the month close.

Thanks,
Oliver

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear note and the CSV. I spoke with Ops and Finance briefly; initial findings: 

- Root cause likely: a small subset of streaming jobs (embedding rebuilds) were counted as tokenized at both the streaming and completion phases in our aggregation window. That double-counting affects high-concurrency batch refreshes and would explain the ~15–22% variance you're seeing.
- Ops is preparing the per-prefix export and an audit zip (will attach).
- Finance: if Atlas provides a VAT registration copy (or confirmation via VIES), we can reissue a reverse-charge invoice and apply a provisional credit for the duplicated tokens while the audit completes.

Proposed next steps: 
1) I'll send a provisional credit note (EUR 9,600) applied to your next invoice immediately.
2) Ops delivers the audit export within 24 hours.
3) If audit confirms double-counting, we'll issue a corrected invoice and a retro credit; if not, we'll provide a detailed reconciliation report explaining the delta.

Can you confirm: a) VAT reg number for reverse-charge and b) who signs off on the credit?

Best,
